name: add_item
description: Add a new task to the user's todo list.

properties.name: text
properties.description: What the task is, in the user's own words. For example: buy a milk.

properties.name: priority
properties.description: Priority from 1 (highest) to 5 (lowest). Defaults to 3 when the user does not say.

name: list_items
description: Return every task on the user's list, oldest first. Use this when the user asks to see the whole list.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Optional filter, either PENDING or DONE. Omit to return tasks in any state.

name: search_items
description: Find tasks whose text matches a query, case-insensitively. Returns the item_id of each match. Call this before update_item or delete_item whenever the user identifies a task by its wording instead of an id.

properties.name: query
properties.description: Words to look for in the task text, for example: milk.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Optional filter, either PENDING or DONE.

name: update_item
description: Change the text and/or the status of one existing task. Requires an item_id obtained from search_items or list_items. At least one of text or status must be supplied.

properties.name: item_id
properties.description: Id of the task to update, as returned by search_items or list_items.

properties.name: text
properties.description: New task text. Omit to leave the wording unchanged.

properties.name: status
properties.description: New status, either PENDING or DONE. Omit to leave the status unchanged.

name: delete_item
description: Permanently remove one task. Requires an item_id obtained from search_items or list_items.

properties.name: item_id
properties.description: Id of the task to delete, as returned by search_items or list_items.
